game.title: Call of Duty: Black Ops III
game.blurb: First-person shooter from Treyarch (RAWG also lists Raven Software, Beenox, Nerve Software and XPEC), released 2015-11-06. RAWG average playtime: 16 hours. Genres: Action, Shooter. Chapters follow the campaign missions and Zombies maps named in the Steam achievements.

chapters.title: Campaign Missions
chapters.summary: Each campaign mission on Hardened, Veteran or Realistic, the full campaign, and the hidden campaign milestones. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Campaign Combat, Upgrades and Collectibles
chapters.summary: Kill feats, Talons and robots, wall runs, Cybernetics Cores, camos and attachments, decorations, collectibles and the training simulator.

chapters.title: Zombies: Shadows of Evil
chapters.summary: Rituals, the Shadowman, GobbleGum, the Civil Protector, Margwas and more in Shadows of Evil.

chapters.title: Zombies: Der Eisendrache
chapters.summary: The ancient bows, the Ragnarok DG-4, Wunderspheres and the hidden main quest in Der Eisendrache.

chapters.title: Zombies: Zetsubou No Shima
chapters.summary: Plants, the Skull of Nan Sapwe, the KT-4, webs and the hidden main quest in Zetsubou No Shima.

chapters.title: Zombies: Gorod Krovi
chapters.summary: Dragons, the Gauntlet of Siegfried, Lockdown Events, Trials and the hidden main quest in Gorod Krovi.

chapters.title: Zombies: Revelations
chapters.summary: The Pack-a-Punch machine, Keepers, Corruption Engines and the two hidden quests in Revelations.

chapters.title: Classic Zombies Maps
chapters.summary: One or two feats each in Shi No Numa, Ascension, Shangri-La, Moon, Origins, Nacht Der Untoten, Verrückt and Kino Der Toten.

attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 311210)
StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Call_of_Duty:_Black_Ops_III
Fandom (callofduty.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://callofduty.fandom.com/wiki/Call_of_Duty:_Black_Ops_III
notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). Steam app 311210 ("Call of Duty®: Black Ops III"); the Multiplayer Starter Pack (app 437350) was not used. StrategyWiki has a stub (completion stage 0, marked as a perfect stub): only its Table of Contents (about 1,100 characters) is written; the Walkthrough, the mission pages (Black Ops, New World, In Darkness, Provocation, Hypocenter, Vengeance, Rise & Fall, Demon Within, Sand Castle, Lotus Towers, Life) and Shadows of Evil are linked but not written, so it was not used. "Life" is on its mission list but has no achievement of its own. callofduty.fandom.com answers the API under "Call of Duty: Black Ops III" with 500 linked articles (the query limit, so possibly more); names only were looked at, nothing copied. 8 of 98 Steam achievements are hidden: 3 campaign ones (CP_REALISTIC_COMPLETE, CP_CAMPAIGN_COMPLETE, CP_UNLOCK_DOA) sit in the campaign chapter, and 5 Zombies ones were placed by their API names (ZM_CASTLE_EE, ZM_ISLAND_COMPLETE_EE, ZM_STALINGRAD_NIKOLAI, ZM_GENESIS_EE, ZM_GENESIS_SUPER_EE) and their position in the list: CASTLE sits with Der Eisendrache, ISLAND with Zetsubou No Shima, STALINGRAD with Gorod Krovi and GENESIS with Revelations. The data does not say which Zombies maps are paid add-ons; the classic maps carry DLC2, DLC4 and DLC5 prefixes in their API names, but no pack names. Only 4 achievements are multiplayer.
